movement.description: The id in the rendering's first line, e.g. P01.

recognised_piece.description: If you recognised the piece, name it; otherwise null.

notes.description: Optional free comments (at most a few sentences).

bar.description: Running bar number as printed after BAR in the rendering.

beat.description: Beat position exactly as printed on the onset line, e.g. 1, 2.5 or "2+1/2".

type.description: cadence = a cadence that does not end a phrase (the phrase continues).

cadence.description: For phrase_end: the cadence that closes the phrase (or none). For cadence events: the cadence type (not none). For phrase_start: always "none".
